## Summary

Describe the user-facing change and why it is needed.

## Related issue

Fixes #

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Breaking change
- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Maintenance or refactoring

## Validation

- [ ] Ruff lint and formatting pass
- [ ] Strict typing passes
- [ ] Tests and coverage gates pass
- [ ] Release-artifact verification passes
- [ ] Home Assistant dev-instance validation was completed when runtime behavior changed
- [ ] Translations and user documentation were updated when applicable
- [ ] No precise coordinates, credentials, raw caches, or unredacted diagnostics are included

## Branch policy

Code changes target `dev`. Maintainer promotions from `dev` to `beta` and from
`beta` to `main` use real merge commits. Do not squash or rebase promotion PRs.
